decisions.reason: Because this dumper was only briefly mentioned in 2019 and appears less differentiated and less central to the firm's niche engineering strengths, management would likely judge it as falling short of aspiration and reallocate resources.

A dedicated page and several models suggest a meaningful commitment in a product area that fits the firm's lifting, customization and service capabilities, so management would likely continue it unless results clearly disappoint.

Inclined building material lifts match the firm's construction-related lifting business and can share know-how, parts and service with related products, making satisfactory performance and retention more likely.

The truck-mounted furniture lift is somewhat narrower and riskier than the core inclined lift lines, but it still fits the firm's vehicle and lifting competences well enough that management would more likely keep it while monitoring results.
